hints.title: Subtree Aggregates
hints.text: A subtree average requires both the sum of node values and the total count of nodes in that subtree.

hints.title: Post-Order Aggregation
hints.text: Return a pair containing subtree sum and subtree node count from each recursive call to compute parent statistics in constant time.

hints.title: Global Maximum Tracker
hints.text: At each node, compute sum divided by count as a floating point value and update the maximum average seen so far.

hints.title: See the blueprint

complexity.whyNaiveFails: Recomputing subtree sums and node counts independently from each node takes quadratic O(N^2) time.
complexity.spaceTimeTradeoff: Returning both sum and count from children computes all subtree averages in a single post-order pass.
complexity.interviewerExpectation: Candidate should handle floating point division and post-order recursive return tuples cleanly.
complexity.notes: Leaf nodes have subtree average equal to their own value.
